description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code that handles dynamic UI updates for the order return process in a web application. It sets up an event listener for a dropdown change and makes an AJAX request to fetch and populate status options based on the selected return header type.

methods.name: changeStatusCorrespondingToHeaderType
methods.description: Function that sends an AJAX request to fetch status items for a selected return header type and updates the status dropdown options accordingly.
